title.narrative: INVESTO IN MALI: SOSTEGNO ALL’OCCUPAZIONE GIOVANILE E ALLO SVILUPPO DELLE PICCOLE E MEDIE IMPRESE IN AMBITO RURALE
Invest in Mali: support for youth employment and the development of small and medium sized enterprises in rural areas

description.narrative: La presente proposta di intervento mira a promuovere l’impiego in ambito rurale grazie al sostegno finanziario e alla formazione di attori economici come le micro, le piccole e le medie imprese, gruppi di donne e cooperative agricole, che intervengono in alcune filiere prioritarie in Mali (mango, orticoltura, karité, sesamo). Il programma interverrà nelle regioni rurali del sud del Mali, regione di Sikasso e Koulikoro al fine di rafforzare le condizioni locali di sviluppo e migliorare il reddito dei produttori/trici dando priorità ai giovani e alle donne. La strategia di intervento prevede la realizzazione di attività di programma sviluppate da OSC italiane con un’esperienza consolidata nel settore del sostegno tecnico e finanziario all’imprenditoria rurale, della formazione professionale e dell’inclusione finanziaria dei produttori/trici, dei gruppi rurali e delle cooperative rurali in Mali e della promozione di impiego per i giovani e le donne. La presente proposta prevede lo sviluppo di interventi specifici che saranno formulati e presentati in futuro dalle OSC italiane a seguito di un bando lanciato da Aics Dakar e che ne definirà in modo più specifico obiettivi, attività, risultati, macro-linee di budget nonché tempistiche di realizzazione. Il focus è intervenire per colmare il deficit di un sistema di finanziamento che possa garantire la promozione dell’impiego in ambito rurale. L’obiettivo è quindi il rafforzamento della resilienza delle comunità rurali del sud del Mali attraverso il sostegno del loro sviluppo socioeconomico. La presente proposta si integra completamente con l’iniziativa AID 12844 eseguita dall’ILO (International Labour Organization) intitolata “An Ka Baara – Travail décent et augmentation des revenus dans les filières de la mangue et de l’horticulture moderne” finalizzata alla formazione tecnica specifica e alla creazione di impiego nel settore della trasformazione dei prodotti appartenenti alla filiera del mango e dell’ortofrutta; e con l’iniziativa AID 12834 “Aumento delle opportunità di reddito nei settori del mango e dell’orticoltura moderna attraverso il rafforzamento tecnico gestionale delle cooperative di produttori e dele micro imprese familiari” , sviluppato dalle OSC italiane, che intervengono nel sostegno alla produzione e alla commercializzazione delle filiere agricole del mango e dell’orticoltura nelle stesse regione di intervento. Il progetto si coordinerà e si articolerà anche con le modalità di intervento e le indicazioni operative (attività, beneficiari e tematiche) del programma regionale in istruttoria finanziato da AICS che sarà sviluppato da IFAD in Senegal e Mali e si focalizzerà sulle strategie e le modalità di finanziamento per la valorizzazione degli investimenti degli immigrati.

This proposal aims to promote employment in rural areas through financial support and training for economic actors such as small and medium-sized enterprises, agricultural groups and cooperatives, which are involved in certain priority sectors in Mali (mango, horticulture, karité, sesame). The programme will intervene in the rural regions of southern Mali, Sikasso and Koulikoro regions in order to strengthen local conditions for development and improve the profitability of producers by giving priority to young people and women. The intervention strategy envisages the implementation of programme activities developed by Italian NGOs with consolidated experience in the field of technical and financial support to rural entrepreneurship, vocational training and financial inclusion of producers, rural groups and rural cooperatives in Mali and the promotion of employment for young people and women. This proposal envisages the development of specific interventions that will be formulated and presented in the future by Italian NGOs following a call launched by Aics Dakar and which will define more specifically their objectives, activities, results, macro-budget lines as well as implementation timelines. The focus is on taking action to fill the gap in a funding system that can guarantee the promotion of employment in rural areas. The aim is therefore to strengthen the resilience of rural communities in southern Mali by supporting their socio-economic development. This proposal is fully integrated with the project proposal AID 12844 by the ILO (International Labour Organization) entitled "An Ka Baara – Travail décent et augmentation des revenus dans les filières de la mangue et de l'horticulture modern” aimed at creating employment in the processing sector of products belonging to the mango and fruit and vegetable supply chain; and with AID 12834 "Increasing income opportunities in the mango and modern horticulture sectors through the technical management strengthening of producer cooperatives and micro family enterprises", developed by the Italian CSOs, which intervene in supporting the production and marketing of the agricultural feed and horticulture supply chains in the same region of intervention. The project will also be coordinated and articulated with the methods of intervention and the operational indications (activities, beneficiaries and themes) of the regional program under investigation that will be developed by IFAD and financed by AICS in Senegal and Mali and will focus on strategies and financing methods for the enhancement of immigrants' investments.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
By 2020, substantially reduce the proportion of youth not in employment, education or training

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment

By 2030, eliminate gender disparities in education and ensure equal access to all levels of education and vocational training for the vulnerable, including persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples and children in vulnerable situations
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all

Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all

Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to ownership and control over land and other forms of property, financial services, inheritance and natural resources, in accordance with national laws
